text:
Maya: Heads-up: CedarBank legal just sent a redline. They want 7-year immutable audit retention for certain events, BYOK with HSM escrow option, and a SOC2 evidence export SLA of 24h. Can we triage for the next compliance sprint?
Sam: Ack. 7 years is outside our default models (we do 90d hot / 2y cold). Do we have precedent?
Emily: No direct precedent. Major cost and ops implications. Need scope + pricing before committing. @Jordan can you estimate infra impact?
Jordan: I can do a first pass. 7y for audit logs depends a lot on event cardinality. Rough calc: if we keep ~5k events/day/customer, that's ~1.8M events/yr. With compressed JSON and indexes, ballpark +3.2TB/customer/yr for full audit stream. Cross-region EU replication ramps that.
Maya: Legal clarified they only need a subset: auth events, admin actions, and data-access approvals — not debug traces.
Sam: If subset, we can compress and archive. Proposal: hot 90d for quick queries, cold immutable archive for the 7y window.
Emily: Ops requirement: append-only + tamper evidence. Is S3 Object Lock + Glacier vault acceptable for EU region? We also need signed manifests for chain-of-custody.
Jordan: S3 Object Lock + Glacier works. BYOK with HSM is trickier: we need customer-managed KEKs and an escrow option (HSM attestation). BYOK handshake across accounts requires a KMS import/unwrap flow and onboarding playbook.
Maya: CedarBank explicitly asked for HSM-backed KEK option for regulatory reasons. That means additional procurement/ops and onboarding support.
Sam: Draft launch criteria idea: 1) event schema agreed, 2) cost estimate + pricing appendix, 3) BYOK handshake docs + test cases, 4) SOC2 evidence export validated to meet 24h SLA, 5) legal counter-signed PO.
Emily: Add to that: rollback/fallback policy if BYOK handshake fails — e.g., notify customer + offer temporary host-managed key with explicit consent. Must be opt-in in contract.
Jordan: Quick config example we can use in design doc:
```yaml
audit_retention:
  hot_days: 90
  cold_years: 7
  immutable: true
```
Jordan: Rough schedule: infra + storage design ~2w, dev work for archiving + export ~4w, BYOK escrow integration ~2w, compliance testing + SOC2 evidence runs ~1w. Ballpark ~9 weeks total (parallelize some work).
Maya: CedarBank wants pilot in 8 weeks. We need scope tradeoffs to meet that. Options: (A) pilot with 5y instead of 7y, (B) pilot with narrowed event set (auth/admin only), (C) pilot without HSM (HSM as paid post-pilot).
Sam: I recommend (B) + (C) to hit 8-week pilot. Keeps legal covered and reduces infra lead time. Offer HSM add-on with a clear timeline.
Emily: Agree. I'll draft a scoped pilot proposal to CedarBank with a matrix: event set, retention, BYOK/HSM options, estimated costs. @Jordan can you drop the estimate ranges into the doc?
Jordan: Will add lower/median/upper ranges by EOD.
Maya: Thanks — if legal signs off on pilot path, we can slot this into the next compliance sprint. I'll loop with Legal after Emily's draft. :thumbsup:
OpsBot: Reminder: create ticket INFRA-4512 for S3 Object Lock experiment and attach cost model.
Sam: Filing INFRA-4512 now.
Maya: Closing loop — ping me ASAP if any blocker comes up.
